NamiW.name: Ebb and Flow
NamiW.tooltip:
Nami unleashes a stream of water that bounces between allied and enemy champions. Each champion can only be hit once, and it hits up to @MaxTargets@ targets.
  • Restores @TotalHeal@ Health to allies and will bounce to a nearby enemy champion.
  • Deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage to enemies and will bounce to a nearby allied champion.
    The damage and healing value is modified by @BounceScaling@ each bounce.
    Can only bounce to visible enemies.

NamiQ.tooltip: Nami hurls a bubble, <status>Stunning</status> for @StunDuration@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTT@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

NamiE.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
NamiE.tooltip:
Nami empowers an allied champion's next @HitCount@ Attacks and Abilities for @BuffDuration@ seconds, causing them to Slow their targets by @TotalSlow@ for @SlowDuration@s and deal an additional @TotalDamage@ magic damage.
Deals @AoEMod@ damage to non-champions when empowering area of effect Abilities.

NamiR.name: Tidal Wave
NamiR.tooltip:
Nami summons a tidal wave, Knocking Up for 0.5 seconds, Slowing by @SlowAmount@%, and dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage. The duration of the Slow increases based on distance the wave traveled, up to @MaxSlowDuration@ seconds.

Allies hit by the wave gain double the effect of Surging Tides.
The Slow has a minimum duration of @MinSlowDuration@ seconds.

NamiPassive.name: Surging Tides
NamiPassive.tooltip: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions, they gain <speed>@TotalMSBonus@ Move Speed</speed>, decaying over @BuffDuration@ seconds.
